features.heroTitle: Built for developers with more than one product
features.heroSummary: Pietru solves two problems: managing outgoing email across multiple products with different providers, and capturing inbound email for end-to-end testing. Here's how each piece works.

send.title: Send
send.summary: One dashboard for outgoing email across all your products, regardless of which provider each one uses.
send.detail: Each product connects its own SMTP provider. Pietru routes the mail and gives you a unified view of everything that went out. Welcome emails, receipts, notifications — see them all in one place without logging into three different dashboards.
quickRef: Works with Resend, Amazon SES, Mailgun, and Pietru SMTP
Built-in rate limiting and retry logic

capture.title: Capture
capture.summary: Receive test emails directly into your project. No more creating throwaway Gmail accounts to check if your app sent something.
capture.detail: During development and testing, your app needs to send real emails and you need to verify they arrived. Pietru captures those emails into your project so your tests can inspect them programmatically. No manual inbox checking, no flaky test setups.
quickRef: Share test emails with your team

receive.title: Receive
receive.summary: Accept inbound emails into your project for end-to-end testing. Your API tests can verify email delivery without real mailboxes.
receive.detail: Pietru gives your project a real email address. When your app sends a welcome email during a test, Pietru receives it and makes it available via API. Your test suite can assert on subject, body, and attachments — fully automated, no human checking needed.

track.title: Track
track.summary: See delivery status across all your products in one timeline. Stop guessing whether emails arrived.
track.detail: Every email sent through Pietru generates a delivery event. See when it was accepted, delivered, opened, or bounced — filtered by product, recipient, or time range. One timeline for all your products.

debug.title: Debug
debug.summary: Full message history for every email across every product. Find and fix issues fast.
debug.detail: When an email doesn't arrive or renders wrong, Pietru shows you the full picture: the original payload, the provider's response, rendered HTML, and error details — all in one place, organized by product.

switch.title: Switch
switch.summary: Swap email providers for any product from the dashboard. Your app code doesn't change.
switch.detail: Need to move Product A from Resend to a different provider? Change it in the Pietru dashboard. Your app keeps sending to the same endpoint — we handle the routing. No code deploys, no downtime.

pricing.heroSummary: Start free, scale when you're ready. No surprise fees, no credit card required to get started.

free.name: Free
free.description: For side projects and experimentation. Send up to 1,000 emails per month.

pro.name: Pro
pro.description: For growing products that need reliability and insights. Send up to 50,000 emails per month.

items.a: Yes. Upgrade or downgrade anytime from your dashboard. Changes take effect immediately.

items.q: Do I need a credit card to start?
items.a: No. The Free plan requires no payment info. You only enter billing details when upgrading to Pro.
Every sent email counts as one. Inbound emails and test captures are free and don't count toward your limit.

items.q: Can I use my own email provider?
items.a: Yes. Pietru works with your existing provider. Connect Resend today — more providers are on the way.

items.q: What happens if I exceed my limit?
items.a: We'll notify you when you're approaching your limit. On the Free plan, emails are paused until the next cycle. Pro plans can purchase additional capacity.
